food-luoyang-water-banquet.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: travel food discovery card, landscape 3:2. Create one elegant editorial watercolor and gouache illustration, distinctly hand-painted rather than a photograph. Accurate, appetizing finished food fills about 75 percent of the frame. Three-quarter overhead composition, lightly textured warm ivory paper and restrained soft wash background, natural daylight, rich food color, fine brushwork and clear silhouettes that remain readable as a small card. No text, lettering, watermark, logo, collage, split panels or extra unrelated dishes. Subject: Luoyang Water Banquet represented by its signature Mudan Yancai, a single broad blue-and-white porcelain soup bowl. Delicate cooked white radish threads in clear pale broth, fine shredded ham and mushrooms arranged around an edible pale yellow egg-sheet peony at the center. This is the radish-based peony swallow dish, no real bird nest, no living flower planted in the bowl. The single soup dish dominates the picture, suggesting one course rather than an invented full twenty-four-course table.
